title.narrative: Enhancing food security and income generation through sustainable revitalization of the meat and cowpea value chains in Niger

description.narrative: 3ADI Support Programme for the Republic of Niger - Enhancing food processing issues related to UNIDO mandate and expertise, in synergy with the lessons learned and achievements made by previous interventions implemented in the region and sub region. Objective: Enhanced food security and income generation for vulnerable groups through employment creation and integration in the food processing systems. Through an interactive process with local Institutional counterparts, the Project will adopt an integrated approach to addressing food security and income generation through sustainable revitalization of the meat and cowpeas value chains in Niger; Development partners, finance institutions, producers associations and private sector representatives and two value chains were identified namely meat and cowpeas which will be targeted by the 3ADI-UNIDO Project.
